insertion_grid_summary — DRIVE pegsim op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.insertion_grid_summary(rows) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsim; pegsim.insertion_grid_summary(rows) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("insertion_grid_summary"))

Usage

Aggregates the success-rate grid: from rows {eps_mm, tilt_deg, correct, success}, the table of success rates for with/without correction × ε₀ × θ₀, plus "the largest ε₀ at which everything succeeds without correction" and "successes / total with correction".

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り: eps_mm・tilt_deg(軸)、rate: {False: (n_eps, n_tilt) の配列, True: 同}、n_runs、max_eps_all_ok:

{correct: その補正で全 θ₀ が成功する最大の ε₀(無ければ None)}、success_count: {correct: (成功数, 総数)}。Raises ValueError: 行が空、鍵が欠ける。
